hold_reason: review: Google: A film gate is the opening/frame mechanism in a film camera or projector where film is exposed, not a part on a camera sensor.
objections: Google: A film gate is the opening/frame mechanism in a film camera or projector where film is exposed, not a part on a camera sensor.
NVIDIA: Hindi definition 'कैमरा के सेंसर पर फ़िल्म आकार का भाग' is inaccurate. Film gate is the physical aperture in a camera/projector that defines the exposed image area.

Alibaba: The Hindi description says 'camera ke sensor par film aakar ka bhag' (part of the sensor in the shape of film). This is incorrect. A film gate is the aperture in a film camera through which the film passes. Digital cameras have sensors, not film gates.
